summary: planqc won the 2025 German Founder Award in the Startup category for its work on neutral-atom quantum computing.
quote: For its mission to bring a “Made in Germany” quantum computer based on neutral atoms into industrial application, MPQ spin-off planqc was awarded the prestigious founder award prize in the category Startup on September 9, 2025.

source.publisher: Max Planck Institute of Quantum Optics
